steps.description: The plan's steps, in the order they run.

action.description: What the step does, in a few words.

tool.description: The one tool the step calls.

args_json.description: The tool's arguments as a JSON object, encoded as a string. "$fill" marks a value the executor fills in from earlier results.

depends_on.description: Ids of earlier steps whose results this step uses.

expected_result.description: What the step returns when it worked, checkable from outside.
